title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1989-04-02
lineage: mac > Nakamichi BX-125E > EMU 020 > Wavelab > wav (24/96) > flac *except for It's All Over Now, Baby Blue: mac > Nakamichi ZX-9 > Tascam HD-P2 > wav (24/96) > flac
source: Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Sony WM-D6 > 2 x Maxell SII-S (from Section 9F, Row TT, Seat 8)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Atlanta‑era show captured with surprisingly clear Nakamichi audience mics, delivering a solid listening experience after modest EQ tweaks.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the concert’s electric atmosphere and audience excitement, calling it a really good show. The recording, made with Nakamichi microphones, is noted for its full‑range capture of vocals, drums and harmonies, avoiding the tinny or muddy qualities of other sources, though a volume boost and some reprocessing are recommended for optimal sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both strong performance and relatively good recording quality, but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Nakamichi mics capture full frequency range, clear vocal harmonies and drums; avoids tinny twanginess and muddiness of other versions. Requires a modest volume increase and possible EQ/reprocessing for non‑high‑end speaker setups.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a really good show with overwhelming audience electricity and excitement, reflecting the high energy of preceding Atlanta dates.
